description: List every value a Eurostat dataset carries in one dimension, with codes and labels exactly as published: when eurostat_get_dataset_info's sample is not enough, or to confirm filter codes before querying. Narrow a long list with filter (words in a code or label) or code_prefix (the codes under a parent, such as one country's regions), and page with cursor. Pass canvas_id to also stage the whole list as a table, to label a download's codes through a join.

canvas_id.description: Also stage the dimension's whole list on this canvas, whatever filter, code_prefix and limit, narrowed only by an explicit geo_level: columns code and label, plus level for geo (NULL for a code with no NUTS level). Without geo_level a geo table holds every level, aggregates and regions beside the countries they contain, so filter level before summing or averaging. Pass the canvasId of a eurostat_query_dataset or eurostat_download_dataset response; this tool never starts a canvas. First call only, not with cursor. Ignored without a dataframe canvas.

code_prefix.description: Keep values whose code starts with this text, ignoring case: the codes under a parent where codes nest by prefix ("DE" with geo_level "nuts2" lists the German NUTS 2 regions; a CN heading lists its codes, itself included). Aggregates outside the code tree are not reached. Up to 100 characters, no wildcards. Applies at the effective geo_level, with filter, before paging.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first. Bound to dataset_code, dimension (any accepted spelling), geo_level, filter and code_prefix, so send those unchanged.

dataset_code.description: Dataset code (e.g., "nama_10_gdp", or "DS-045409" for a Comext collection).

dimension.description: Dimension code (e.g., "geo", "unit"), matched exactly, then ignoring case; TIME_PERIOD aliases time. eurostat_get_dataset_info lists them.

filter.description: Words to find, up to 500 characters: keeps values whose code and label, joined by a space, contain every word as a substring, in any order, ignoring case and accents. Punctuation is part of a word; spellings are not transliterated ("münchen" does not find MUENCHEN). Applies to the whole list at the effective geo_level before paging, in Eurostat's order.

geo_level.description: NUTS level, for the "geo" dimension only (rejected with any other): "aggregate" (EU/EA codes), "country" (2-letter codes, the inline default), "nuts1", "nuts2", "nuts3".

limit.description: Values per page, default 25; values above 1,000 clamp to 1,000 with a notice. Fixed by the first call and ignored with cursor.

name: eurostat_get_dimension_values

canvasId.description: Canvas holding the staged list; omitted when nothing was staged.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The dataset code or dimension code does not exist. `no_results`: The dataset has no geo values at the geo_level passed, or at the country default when nothing was staged. `conflicting_params`: geo_level was passed for a dimension other than "geo", or canvas_id with cursor where a canvas runs. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed, belongs to another dataset_code, dimension, geo_level, filter or code_prefix, or resumes after a code the list no longer holds. `upstream_fault`: Eurostat returned a dataset structure this server cannot read, or refused the structure read, which is not retried; marked retryable when the structure endpoint failed or could not be reached on every retry. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is unknown or expired. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

geoLevel.description: NUTS level of the inline values, for geo only: country when geo_level was omitted.

matchCount.description: Values passing filter and code_prefix across the whole list, before paging; only when either was passed.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted on the last page.

notice.description: Clamp disclosure, continuation routes, why a filter or code_prefix matched nothing, and, for a geo table staged without geo_level, its rows per level and the overlap warning, or the geo_level that lists one of its levels inline.

stagedRowCount.description: Rows staged: totalCount, or for a geo table staged without geo_level, every level (the dataset's geo valuesCount).

tableName.description: Staged table (VARCHAR code and label, plus level for geo). Call eurostat_dataframe_describe with canvasId, then join it in eurostat_dataframe_query.

totalCount.description: Values the dimension lists, at geoLevel for geo, before filter, code_prefix and paging. 0 only when the dataset lists no country values and an every-level geo table was staged.

truncated.description: True when more values follow; pass nextCursor as cursor for them.

values.description: This page of values in Eurostat's order: for geo, those at geoLevel; with filter or code_prefix, the matches. Up to limit; truncated and nextCursor say when more follow.

items.description: A dimension value code and label pair.

code.description: Value code, the filter value in eurostat_query_dataset and eurostat_download_dataset.

title: Get Eurostat Dimension Values
